text:
maria (sec-eng): Quick sync — clarifying SOC2 scope for audit logs & KMS/HSM vendors. Do we have a single owner for audit-log ingest pipeline and a separate owner for KMS rotation evidence?

jonathan (eng-ml): I can own the auditlog ingest schema + proof-of-ingest questions. What's the milestone for fieldwork evidence?

maria (sec-eng): Target for fieldwork readiness is 2024-06-14 (legal needs final scope by then). We need: retention proof, structured metadata presence, and KMS rotation docs.

lee (eng-platform): Platform owns key provisioning and rotation automation. HSM attestation (vendor-supplied) is a dependency — we'll need vendor SLA and attestation dates. @sam can you confirm retention config for prod/staging?

sam (eng-sre): Retention: prod = 13 months, staging = 90 days. For SOC2 we need a documented retention test and evidence that records include `tenant_id`, `request_id`, and `service` fields. Also note: logs currently include raw user-agent; we should redact PII fields per @anna guidance.

anna (product): Agree on redaction. No customer-managed keys for hosted product in this scope. If a customer requests BYOK later, we'll handle separately.

maria (sec-eng): Action items: (1) @jonathan: map ingest owners + schema and open PR by EOD Tue. (2) @lee: confirm vendor attestation timeline and send to legal. (3) @sam: add metadata fields + retention smoke test and post evidence. I'll update the control evidence doc and dep map.

jonathan (eng-ml): quick FYI — PR for schema started: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auditlog/pull/78. Comments welcome. :eyes:

sam (eng-sre): I'll add a smoke test script and a retention check. Example check I'll run for ingestion counts:
```
# check last 30 days ingestion count for inference service
curl -s 'https://logs.redwood.internal/api/search?q=service:inference&days=30' | jq '.count'
```
I'll post results to the evidence folder when done.

lee (eng-platform): Vendor asked for our SOC2 scope list and key owner mapping. @maria can you share the minimal mapping (key id -> environment -> owner)?

maria (sec-eng): Uploaded a minimal mapping to the compliance doc (internal link): https://internal.redwood/docs/compliance/soc2/scope. I also uploaded `kms-rotation-plan.draft` there.

audit-bot: evidence uploaded: `kms-rotation-plan.draft.pdf` (uploaded by maria) :white_check_mark:

jonathan (eng-ml): Added schema comments in the PR requesting review from @lee and @sam. Left notes about timestamps needing RFC3339.

sam (eng-sre): Reviewed the PR, left minor comments on timestamp indexing and retention TTLs. Will follow up in the PR thread with the smoke-test output.

maria (sec-eng): Thanks. I'll consolidate owners into the milestone table and ping legal for vendor attestation acceptance criteria. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
